answer: Influence can be minted only against net external inflow: each epoch the ledger nets payments between identities sharing funding sources, and only money entering a cluster from outside raises its members' limits. Circular trades cancel out, like copper wires carrying current in a loop and doing no work. A lotus of fake buyers blooming inside one cluster adds nothing, while one real customer payment counts once. A sybil farmer must therefore buy genuine outside demand for every fake, and a gale of internal volume cannot inflate standing.
